# MICCAI Explorer

> Every accepted MICCAI paper from 2021 to 2025 (3,717 of them) joined to its published peer reviews (11,359), its rebuttal and meta-reviews, and the official oral and spotlight program. Built and maintained by Kumar Abhishek.

MICCAI (Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention)
is one of the few large conferences that publishes the full review
record for every accepted paper: reviewer scores, confidence
ratings, written reviews, author rebuttals, and meta-reviews. It
separately publishes a program booklet naming which papers were
given a talk. This project is the first to join those two sources,
which is what makes questions like "do oral papers actually score
higher, once early acceptance is controlled for?" answerable from
public data.

## What the data supports, and what it does not

- Coverage is **accepted papers only**. MICCAI does not publish
  reviews for rejected submissions, so nothing here describes what
  gets rejected, and acceptance-rate figures come from MICCAI's own
  reported submission counts rather than from this data.
- Review scores are **not comparable across years without
  normalization**: the scale was 1-9 in 2021, 1-8 in 2022 and 2023,
  and 1-6 from 2024. Cross-year comparisons here are expressed as a
  percentage of that year's scale, or with Cliff's delta, which is
  ordinal and scale-free.
- Subject-area counts are **not comparable across the 2024/2025
  boundary**. MICCAI replaced its taxonomy in 2025, from 31 ad-hoc
  facets to six required ones, so the median paper carries 5 tags
  against 3 the year before. An area can appear to grow fourfold
  with no research having moved.
- Early acceptance is a **confounder, not a footnote**. Orals are
  drawn from accepted papers and early accepts are decided before
  rebuttal, so any oral-versus-poster score gap is reported within
  early and non-early strata as well as pooled.

## Pages

- [MICCAI Papers and Peer Reviews, 2021 to 2025](https://miccai-explorer.github.io/): Explore 3,717 MICCAI papers and 11,359 public peer reviews from 2021 to 2025: semantic map, acceptance rates, reviewer scores, and subject-area trends.
- [Which MICCAI Papers Get a Talk? Orals and Spotlights](https://miccai-explorer.github.io/orals.html): 377 MICCAI oral and spotlight talks matched to their papers and reviews: score effect sizes, early-acceptance strata, and which areas get picked.
- [All 3,717 MICCAI Papers, 2021 to 2025](https://miccai-explorer.github.io/papers.html): Search and filter all 3,717 accepted MICCAI papers, 2021 to 2025, by year, subject area, reviewer score, and code release. Links to PDFs, DOIs, and code.
- [About the Data and Method](https://miccai-explorer.github.io/about.html): How MICCAI Explorer is built: the proceedings and reviews it reads, the SPECTER2 embeddings behind the semantic map, the statistics, and the known limitations.
- [MICCAI 2025 (Daejeon, Korea): Papers and Reviews](https://miccai-explorer.github.io/year/2025.html): MICCAI 2025 in Daejeon, Korea: 1,027 accepted papers with reviewer scores, subject areas, top-rated papers, co-authorship, and code-release rates.
- [MICCAI 2024 (Marrakesh, Morocco): Papers and Reviews](https://miccai-explorer.github.io/year/2024.html): MICCAI 2024 in Marrakesh, Morocco: 856 accepted papers with reviewer scores, subject areas, top-rated papers, co-authorship, and code-release rates.
- [MICCAI 2023 (Vancouver, Canada): Papers and Reviews](https://miccai-explorer.github.io/year/2023.html): MICCAI 2023 in Vancouver, Canada: 730 accepted papers with reviewer scores, subject areas, top-rated papers, co-authorship, and code-release rates.
- [MICCAI 2022 (Singapore): Papers and Reviews](https://miccai-explorer.github.io/year/2022.html): MICCAI 2022 in Singapore: 573 accepted papers with reviewer scores, subject areas, top-rated papers, co-authorship, and code-release rates.
- [MICCAI 2021 (Strasbourg, France (Virtual)): Papers and Reviews](https://miccai-explorer.github.io/year/2021.html): MICCAI 2021 in Strasbourg, France (Virtual): 531 accepted papers with reviewer scores, subject areas, top-rated papers, co-authorship, and code-release rates.
- [MICCAI 2026 (Strasbourg, France): Accepted Papers](https://miccai-explorer.github.io/year/2026.html): MICCAI 2026 in Strasbourg, France: 1,166 accepted papers from the program booklet, with authors and co-authorship. Peer reviews are not published yet.

## Data

- [papers.json](https://miccai-explorer.github.io/papers.json): the full browse index as one JSON file. Every paper with its year, authors, subject areas, mean reviewer score, individual scores, early-acceptance flag, presentation type, and links to PDF, DOI, code, and datasets. Subject-area names are listed once under `areas` and referenced by position.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/miccai-explorer/miccai-explorer.github.io): the scrapers, the parsers for each era of MICCAI's page format, the analysis, and the site build. The raw per-year JSON and the committed embeddings are in `data/`.

## Optional

- [How it was built](https://miccai-explorer.github.io/about.html): sources, scraping, SPECTER2 embeddings, clustering, and the statistics used.
- [Write-up](https://pixels-and-predictions.pages.dev/posts/miccai_explorer/): the longer narrative account of the project and what it found.

Last built 2026-09-16. MICCAI papers and reviews remain the copyright of their respective authors; this analysis is by Kumar Abhishek.
